source.title: A Closer Look at Deep Learning Heuristics: Learning rate restarts, Warmup and Distillation
source.authors: Akhilesh Deepak Gotmare; N. Keskar; Caiming Xiong; R. Socher

record.tranche_reason: The paper measures representational similarity for training-progress and distillation questions, but does not test any listed convergence claim version or rely on convergence as a finding.
record.gate_note: The CCA results concern similarities between checkpoints within training runs and between a teacher and student. They do not test convergence with model scale, across independent seeds, or the other listed versions. These related measurements are recorded with versions ["none"].
record.test_reason: The study uses SVCCA to compare checkpoints within single training runs (SGDR, warmup) and a teacher with two students (distilled and hard-label). It never compares independently trained models across scale, seeds or modalities, and never tests mapping or shared features. Li et al. 2015 (Convergent Learning) appears only as a reference, and Raghu et al. 2017 is cited as the tool. Nothing in the results bears on any version, so T6. The relation is cites_only rather than discusses, because the paper never discusses representational convergence.
record.authors_conclusion: Mostly correct. The paraphrase should add the authors' first conclusion: the usual explanations for cosine annealing's success (escaping local minima) are not borne out, and the decay rather than the restarts may matter most. They also find that warmup's effect can be reproduced by freezing the FC stack early.
record.recipe_differences: The study uses CCA to analyze training dynamics and distillation; it does not apply a method for testing the listed convergence claims.
record.method_sensitivity: The reported CCA patterns differ across the small-batch, large-batch-without-warmup, and large-batch-with-warmup setups.

fits_no_version.finding: In VGG-11, the iter0 versus iter200 CCA similarity of the FC stack rises for small-batch and large-batch-with-warmup training. The rise is absent for large-batch training without warmup.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Warmup limits large early changes in deeper-layer representations during large-batch training.

fits_no_version.finding: For SGDR on VGG-16, shallow layers stay more similar than deep layers between early and late checkpoints. A restart barely changes representations.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Learning-rate restarts have limited effect on layer representations, especially in shallow layers.

fits_no_version.finding: Distilled and hard-label students have similar CCA similarity to the teacher in shallow layers. The differences are concentrated in the FC stack.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Distillation's representational effect is concentrated in the student's deeper layers.

record.problems: The CCA results are presented as heatmaps without numerical values or reported uncertainty; several conclusions are qualitative and based on a limited set of architectures and training setups.
record.rows_left_out: No other results were left out. The mode-connectivity and accuracy results concern training heuristics rather than the listed representation-convergence versions.

untested.parts: No comparison of independently trained models across scale or capability.
No vision-language or paired cross-modal comparison.
No comparison of same-architecture networks from different initializations. Comparisons are within one run (checkpoints).
No linear mapping, stitching or relative-representation test.
No interpretable feature or circuit comparison across models.
No variation of similarity metric, its settings or input distribution.
No test of the extent or causes of cross-model alignment.

record.verdict_notes: All CCA results are heatmaps without numbers or uncertainty. The mode-connectivity results concern the loss landscape, not representations, and are correctly left out.

versions.untested_parts: No comparison of independent models across model scale or capability.
No paired image-caption or vision-language comparison.
No comparison of independently initialized networks for shared features or subspaces.
No mapping, stitching, relative-representation, or unpaired interchangeability test.
No test for recurring interpretable features or circuits.
No study of how similarity results vary with metric settings or input distribution.
No test of whether shared data or objectives explain cross-model convergence.

rows.subject: VGG-16
rows.operation_detail: Compared CCA layer similarities between models at epochs 10 and 150 of SGDR training.
rows.note: The text says shallower layers show closer resemblance than deeper layers between partially and fully trained models, as also seen with standard SGD.

rows.subject: VGG-16
rows.operation_detail: Compared CCA layer similarities between models immediately before and after an SGDR restart.
rows.note: The authors describe the restart as not greatly affecting representations, particularly in shallower layers.

rows.subject: VGG-11
rows.operation_detail: Compared CCA layer similarities between initialization and the end of warmup.
rows.note: The text reports increased similarity in the final fully connected layers for this setup.

rows.subject: VGG-11
rows.operation_detail: Compared CCA layer similarities between initialization and the end of warmup.
rows.note: The text says the increase in similarity for the final fully connected layers seen in the other stated setups is absent here.

rows.subject: VGG-11
rows.operation_detail: Compared CCA layer similarities between initialization and the end of warmup.
rows.note: The text reports increased similarity in the final fully connected layers for this setup.

rows.subject: VGG-11
rows.operation_detail: Compared CCA layer similarities between the end of warmup and the end of training.
rows.note: The paper presents this comparison but gives no separate numerical result in the text.

rows.subject: Sdistilled
rows.stage_stated: trained using the teacher's predicted probability distribution
rows.operation_detail: Compared student layer representations with the teacher using CCA.
rows.measure: CCA similarity between teacher and student layers
rows.note: The authors compare this student's teacher similarity with that of the independently trained student and describe their shallow-layer scores as similar.

rows.subject: Sindep.
rows.operation_detail: Compared student layer representations with the teacher using CCA.
rows.measure: CCA similarity between teacher and student layers
rows.note: Compared with the distilled student, the paper describes the main difference in teacher similarity as occurring in the deeper fully connected stack.
rows.check: This is a hard-label student versus teacher comparison (shallow CNN vs VGG-16), so it is cross-architecture similarity. It serves only as a baseline for the distillation difference. There is no scale or capability trend and no numbers, so it cannot bear on V1 or V3. Keep as none.

source_check.scope: Only the listed rows, labels and statements were checked; presence is not whole-study approval.
